verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is explicitly built for long-running background tasks with no execution timeout, retries, concurrency control, queues, scheduled/cron triggers, and durable AI-agent sessions (chat.agent) that survive crashes/deploys, all directly targeting autonomous background automation. Community reviews corroborate real-world use for async/background AI automation platforms running effortlessly at scale. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of truly unattended multi-day autonomous runs, and some community friction around v3→v4 migration and triggering from frontend.
